answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to a bonded collateral escrow and correlation evidence. When k identities coordinate equivocation, detected evidence triggers aggregate slashing proportional to O(k^2), with losses assigned across the correlated set. Swarm detection additionally multiplies capital loss by e^(αk), α>0, so asymmetric depreciation rapidly exhausts capital; zephyr, lotus, or quill aliases cannot make control economical.
